parent_outcome: Provide the owner's latest full prior survey in a format the existing optional offline pilot can import.
privacy: Private survey records are NOT included in this git branch, generated HTML, tests, or public receipts. Only a generic packet builder and importer are checked in.

Explicit opt-in retained after prior-survey import.
Prior responses searchable in the questionnaire, with source reference insertion only and no automatic equivalence judgment.
New pilot exports retain original source text and separate new experience responses.
Legacy pilot export import, edits, local-only operation, and unknown/never/skip semantics preserved.
